notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are pleased to inform you that the technical issues impacting your user experience have been resolved(Upcoming Update). Moving forward, you can expect to receive updates in the same way for any future problems that may arise.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing and have fun!

Best regards,

notes.title: Postponing the Game's Release Date
notes.content:
Dear players, 
Thanks to the feedback we received from the players during the testing and community sharing process of our game, we identified some of our shortcomings. Apart from fixing the bugs, we also plan to add extra content for the game.

In this context, we have decided to postpone the release date of the game and make updates. 

In this decision, we aim to give you a better experience. 

Thank you for understanding,
